title: Building Production-Grade Agents
description: Take a support agent for the fictional store Parcelpine from a one-hour demo to a release you can trust: launch-day triage, eval gates, tools, context and memory, retrieval, orchestration, security and a local release pipeline. For anyone with basic Python, no AI experience needed; runs on Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek or free open models. Every lesson has a reader, a runnable lab and an interview hub.
author: Vinod Seth
